gap: No result ChatGPT got states which Apple cases the $59 Apple Crossbody Strap actually fits by iPhone model. On iPhone 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max it fits only the TechWoven and Silicone cases, not the Clear Case. On iPhone 17 and 17e it fits only the Silicone Case. On iPhone Air it fits the Air Case and the Air Bumper. Only the iPhone 18 Pro Clear Case was redesigned to be 'now compatible'.
standout_why: I read cameralookout.com (iPhone 18 Pro straps, 2026-10-20, not cited by ChatGPT). It says Apple names three iPhone 18 Pro case families (TechWoven, Silicone, Clear) and that CASETiFY has 'listed exceptions' without saying what they are. It says nothing about the iPhone 17 or 17 Pro, the 17 Pro Clear Case exclusion, 17e or Air. I could not compare against two pages: the cited Bandolier Palmer Duet page returned HTTP 429 and the AppleInsider crossbody-strap page returned HTTP 403. I did not open Wired, Macworld, Cult of Mac, WSJ, NBC or Good Housekeeping because of the tool budget, so a non-cited result could carry part of this.
decides: ChatGPT asked the shopper which model they have (17, 16, 18 or older) and only showed third-party combo cases. The finding sets the branch. An iPhone 17 Pro owner who already has Apple's Clear Case can't use Apple's strap and needs a strap-card or combo case (Bandolier, CASETiFY, Casepeach) or a Silicone or TechWoven case. An iPhone 18 Pro owner can use the $49 Clear Case plus the $59 strap. iPhone 16 and older have no Apple case on the list, which points them to the third-party options.

findings.value: iPhone 18 Pro / 18 Pro Max: TechWoven, Silicone and Clear Case with MagSafe. iPhone 17 Pro / 17 Pro Max: TechWoven and Silicone Case with MagSafe only. iPhone 17: Silicone Case with MagSafe. iPhone 17e: Silicone Case with MagSafe. iPhone Air: iPhone Air Bumper and iPhone Air Case with MagSafe.

findings.label: How Apple straps attach / the exclusion rule
findings.value: The connector's cord loop threads from the outside through one of the small openings on the bottom corners of the case and is locked with a metal ring. Apple says only 'select Apple iPhone cases are compatible'.
findings.source_title: How to attach and adjust Crossbody Strap or Wrist Strap – Apple Support
findings.note: Published 2026-09-09. The support page doesn't list models and doesn't address third-party cases. Any case without the two bottom-corner openings can't take Apple's strap.
